To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the performance of an indoor BPLC system using OFDM techniques is affected by the presence of branches and the impedance mismatch at the line terminals.
multipaths within a BPLC network affect the performance of an OFDM-based BPLC system.
OFDM techniques are suitable for broadband power-line communication systems, but the multipath in a BPLC channel affects the system performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the performance evaluation of OFDM techniques for indoor broadband power-line communication systems.
the effects of multipath on OFDM techniques for indoor BPLC systems.

the effects of multipath and terminal impedance changes in an indoor channel on the performance of an OFDM-based BPLC system and the use of concatenated Reed-Soloman codes and interleaved Viterbi codes to improve the system performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the performance of OFDM-based BPLC system is highly dependent on the network topology and the impedances of the branches.
the performance of the BPLC system is highly dependent on the multipaths and their variations in the indoor channels.
the performance degradation due to multipath is significant, and the concatenated RS/IV methods are an effective solution to overcome such degradation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
when the line impedance is close to the line characteristic impedance and the branch terminal impedances are also close to the line impedance, then OFDM techniques are efficient in a BPLC network.
when the terminal impedences of the indoor channel are close to short circuits or open circuits, then OFDM techniques show poor performance.
the performance of an OFDM system in a BPLC network is affected by the multipath due to branches and changes in the terminal impedance of the branches.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the OFDM technique can be used in a BPLC network for data transmission.

the OFDM techniques can be effectively used for indoor BPLC networks, and the performance degradation due to multipath can be mitigated by using concatenated Reed-Soloman codes and interleaved Viterbi techniques.
the performance of a BPL system can be improved by concatenating RS codes/interleaving Viterbi codes.
